properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: The secret key used to sign and verify JSON Web Tokens.

properties.name: wx.appid
properties.description: The WeChat mini program application ID.

properties.name: wx.secret
properties.description: The secret credential for the WeChat mini program.

properties.name: wx.mini-program-env
properties.description: The WeChat mini program environment identifier returned in login responses: dev, trial, or release. Defaults to dev.

properties.name: wx.phone-api-url
properties.description: The WeChat API URL used to exchange a phone authorization code for the user's phone number.

properties.name: wx.mock-login-enabled
properties.description: Whether to allow login to fall back to a mock WeChat session when credentials are missing or certain API calls fail. Does not apply to phone number binding. Defaults to false.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: The validity period of JSON Web Tokens in milliseconds from issuance. Defaults to 604800000 (7 days).
